item.tib: yang snying gsang ba'i thugs sgrub las sri mnan gnam lcags rgya gram
item.coloph: de ltar dam sri mnan pa 'di/ dran pa nam mkhas phyi rabs don/ las kyi mtha' gnon bstan pa'o// ces pa'i dam sri mnan pa 'di ni gsang gling gter ma'o/ yi ge pa ni mchog sprul g.yung drung bstan 'dzin gyis bgyis pa'o//
